definitions.short: Buz , the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H938. Buz III. בּוּז proper name, masculine (compare Assyrian proper name, of a location Bâzu Dl Pa 307; ZK 1885, 93 f. ) 1 2nd son of Nahor, Abraham's brother Gen 22:21 J; = tribe named with דְּדָן & תֵּימָא Jer 25:23 . 2 a Gadite 1Chr 5:14 .
